12 Bamburi Cement Limited
Annual Report & Financial Statements 2015

Group Managing Director Statement
2015 was a year of strong improvement
that marked great progress for the
Group propelled by an improvement
in market conditions and economic
growth in both countries in which
we have a physical presence and
improvement in our operational
performance.
Health and Safety Achievements in 2015
Health and Safety remain a key priority as it is an important pillar
in building a sustainable and profitable business. We continued to
improve our health and safety culture and in creating a zero harm
environment. In the year, we did not have any fatality in all our
industrial sites, but unfortunately had one fatality on the road in
Uganda, of a hired transport driver.
In Kenya, we have remained on course with the health and safety
leadership training for our leadership teams and we target to
complete this in 2016. We sustained our focus on other leading
indicators like the Visible Felt Leadership (VFL) Program which
allows the business leaders to take time on the shop floor
observing and engaging supervisors and frontline workers.
On road safety, the 8th edition of the 2015 Pre-Christmas
Road Safety Awareness Campaign was held in December
2015 with the event kicking off at the Nairobi Grinding
Plant. Similarly in Uganda, we remained on course
focusing on building a positive culture through
emphasis on proactive indicators aimed at addressing
attitudes and behaviour. We further commissioned a
roadmap towards excellence in Road Safety by 2017,
through sustained road safety programs driven by
transporters, refurbished check points, continued
focus on driver management including uniformed
drivers and use of biometrics and automated
journey management.
